title: Silicon Valley star takes CTO reins at Luminance
markdown:
Luminance, the pioneer of Legal-Grade™ AI for enterprise legal teams, has snared a big-hitting executive steeped in West Coast and Silicon Valley know-how, to become Chief Technology Officer based in Cambridge UK.

![Thumbnail](https://ik.imagekit.io/businessweekly/thumbnails/Greg-Pelander_Luminance_41RK7PL80.jpg)

Greg Pelander. Image courtesy – Luminance.

Greg Pelander will be responsible for Luminance’s technology strategy, engineering execution and infrastructure. He has nearly two decades of engineering leadership at prominent West Coast and Silicon Valley technology companies under his belt.

Most recently, as VP of Engineering for Product and AI at ClickUp, he scaled the company's engineering organisation as it grew into one of the most widely used productivity platforms in the world. Before that, he spent eight years at SurveyMonkey leading engineering across multiple product lines, and six years at Yahoo.

The hire follows a period of rapid technical expansion at Luminance. In January, Luminance introduced architecture that retains negotiation history and legal decision-making across contracts, giving enterprises a permanent institutional memory.

This month Luminance’s Autonomous Negotiation (previously called Autopilot) which allows fully automated agent-to-agent contract negotiation, was expanded company-wide, no longer limiting it to legal teams.

“Greg’s track record of building strong engineering cultures at leading Silicon Valley companies and aligning technical strategy with business outcomes makes him an outstanding addition to our leadership team,” said Eleanor Lightbody, CEO of Luminance.

“He’s the perfect person to lead technology development as we look to continue our rapid global expansion.”

Pelander added: “Luminance’s technology stands alone in Legal and Enterprise AI, and that’s because they’re fearless about pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. The opportunity to build on Luminance’s global success and take things even further is exciting, and I’m proud to join this exceptional team.”

Developed by AI experts from the University of Cambridge, Luminance’s Legal-Grade™ AI redefines enterprise decision-making, turning contracts from administration burden into strategic intelligence.

Luminance’s multi-agent platform automates entire workflows, from creation and negotiation to risk review and compliance. It understands clauses, evaluates legal and commercial impact, takes action and learns from every negotiation, becoming increasingly attuned to a business. The technology is rusted by more than 1,000 of the world’s largest enterprises across 70+ countries.
